children: Overview
U.S. regional bank's Q3 net income rose yr/yr on higher net interest income
Loans outstanding grew 2.2% from prior quarter, book value per share up 2.8%
Nonperforming assets remained low at 0.31% of total assets
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
Result Drivers
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said higher net interest income after provision for credit losses was main driver of Q3 pretax profit growth
LOAN GROWTH - Loans outstanding net of deferred fees and discounts increased $42.8 million, or 2.2%, from prior quarter
NONINTEREST INCOME - Co said modest increase in noninterest income, mainly from ATM fees and bank-owned life insurance income, contributed to results
